scenario: [LGRA.2.9.6.5] — three specs in one log line are applied at runtime, not passed through as text. Each compiles to a ValuePrim of the log's InterpExpr (RLOW.6.4) — `04d` to { zero, width 4, d }, `.2f` to { precision 2, f }, `x` to { x lowercase } — and the runtime renders them itself: libds's `render_value` on this lane, Mercury's renderer in `test_behave`. The rendering rules themselves are pinned by `LGRA.2.9.6.10.render`.
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    id: String key
    n: Int mutable
    x: Float mutable
    h: Int mutable

rule show:
    Reading r
->
    log critical "[{r.n:04d}][{r.x:.2f}][{r.h:x}]"
